overview: Retail occupies the lower levels. The building pack distinguishes ordinary three-bedroom homes from upper-level penthouses.
research.locationNote: Meydan Horizon, Dubai; confirm the selected home’s orientation and lagoon access.
research.priceNote: The developer publishes no starting price here. Property Finder’s AED 1,800,209 launch reference is not current inventory; its developer release is marked sold out.
research.paymentNote: Published reference: 20% booking, 40% instalments and 40% completion. Confirm the selected unit’s calendar and eligibility.
research.handoverNote: Developer target May 2028, corroborated by Property Finder; completion unverified.
